home.proof.subhead: THREE PROOFS YOUR SCORE REFLECTS REAL PROGRESS
home.proof.repeatableFront: Run the same session twice and you get the same result.
home.proof.repeatableReveal: The scoring pipeline is deterministic and checksum-verified, so identical input produces identical output.
home.proof.realisticFront: Reference pace is physics-based, not arbitrary.
home.proof.realisticReveal: Corner expectations are derived from vehicle behavior and track geometry, so coaching stays grounded in race reality.
home.proof.contextFront: Grip, weather, and setup changes are recognized.
home.proof.contextReveal: Condition-aware adjustments keep progress tracking fair from session to session and weekend to weekend.

One upload powers both workflows — coaching flows into strategy without re-importing or switching tools.
